description: Records an objection to direct marketing for one record, by record id or email hash. Scope licensee suppresses it for your organisation at once; scope emailmovers suppresses it database-wide within one working day and tells every licensee holding it. Free; it needs suppressions:write, and repeating the same objection returns the same suppression. Call it whenever a contact objects, in any channel. Lawful basis is UK GDPR Article 6(1)(f) legitimate interests; email audiences include corporate subscribers only by default (PECR), so sole traders and ordinary partnerships are left out unless the toggle is changed.

inputSchema.description: An objection to direct marketing, to record and propagate: exactly one of record_id or email_sha256.

email_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the trimmed, lower cased address, when the record id is not known.

received_at.description: RFC 3339 date and time, with Z or an offset such as +01:00.

record_id.description: Format: a contact id: contact_ followed by a 26 character ULID in upper case Crockford base32, such as contact_01JA9X2V7XN3M9R6T1Y5W8ZAK8.

scope.description: licensee suppresses the record for your organisation at once; emailmovers suppresses it database-wide within one working day.

name: report_objection

outputSchema.description: The suppression an objection created. Database-wide objections reach every licensee holding the record through the suppression.created webhook.

anyOf.description: Format: a contact id: contact_ followed by a 26 character ULID in upper case Crockford base32, such as contact_01JA9X2V7XN3M9R6T1Y5W8ZAK8.

status.description: suppressed now, or pending until the database-wide overlay applies.

suppression_id.description: The list the record now sits on.

title: Report an objection
